notes.title: Changelogs #25.07.30 - Alpha
notes.content: [h1]Changelogs #25.07.30[/h1][p][/p][p]With this patch, we are adding our newest weapon, Heavy Machine Gun (HMG), and making a change to our Team Deathmatch mode, turning it into a (FFA) Deathmatch to allow a small and uneven number of players to enjoy the game without having to “sit” and wait for others. Aside from that, we revisited some existing maps to reduce their gameplay frustrations and made a few other minor adjustments.[/p][p][/p][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Disabled dodges resetting your vertical velocity and using a lower gravity in favour of keeping your existing vertical velocity and using regular gravity, allowing you to jump and dodge instantly for tricks without having to wait for the peak[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Game Modes[/h3][p]Team Deathmatch:[/p][list][*][p]Disabled until further notice[/p][/*][/list][p]Deathmatch:[/p][list][*][p]Added with a limit of 6 players and only a time limit of 15 minutes until we decide on a score limit as well[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Animations[/h3][list][*][p]Slightly improved left and right walljump animations[/p][/*][*][p]Switched to a new forward jump style, adding a side flip to start[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Weapons[/h3][p]Heavy Machine Gun (Item: Wildfire)[/p][list][*][p]Added the weapon with placeholder VFX and SFX[/p][/*][*][p]LMB has a fire rate of 12 bullets per second, with each dealing 8 damage, with a similar drop off to Swordgun[/p][/*][*][p]RMB goes into awakened state as long as you keep holding it, initially doing an explosion attack around you for 12 damage while transforming and then starts to shoot[/p][/*][*][p]RMB’s awakened shooting has a fire rate of 16 bullets per second with double the spread on X axis with each dealing 6 damage and pushing enemies back (does not stack)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://i0.wp.com/news.codezin.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/hmg-1.png?resize=953%2C440&ssl=1"][/img][/p][p]Bat (Item: Cyclone)[/p][list][*][p]Added trail effect for normal and spin attacks, in addition to a new VFX for the spin attack[/p][/*][/list][p]Swordgun (Item: Scorpio)[/p][list][*][p]Changed the bullet pattern from a random position of 90-degree slice of a circle to the full circle all around the crosshair[/p][/*][/list][p]Rifle Cannon (Item: Helios)[/p][list][*][p]Fixed explosions not critting behind a cover (done between patches as a quick server fix, now applying to clients as well)[/p][/*][/list][p]Broadsword (Item: Durendal / Founder's Sword)[/p][list][*][p]Changed the strong cut to keep the vertical speed on the jump pads[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Maps[/h3][p]Outer Space:[/p][list][*][p]Removed the majority of the balcony on top of the goal posts, only leaving a small extension[/p][/*][*][p]Switched the goal post to a version without side walls to prevent blocking the entrance without jumping[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the lighting to be brighter[/p][/*][/list][p]Ironworks:[/p][list][*][p]Removed the majority of the tiny ledges, which caused inconsistent results on jumps[/p][/*][*][p]Made some ramps slide better without getting stuck on corners (Experimental)[/p][/*][/list][p]Service Point:[/p][list][*][p]Removed the railings from the  central area, making it easier to climb out of the bottom with walljumps[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Client[/h3][list][*][p]Added more weapons to HUB[/p][/*][*][p]Changed character shader to exaggerate received lighting[/p][/*][*][p]Changed walljump effect (WIP)[/p][/*][*][p]Changed some weapon textures to match their designs better, mostly on colours[/p][/*][*][p]Changed weapon shaders to match player ones[/p][/*][/list][p]Note: Dissolve timings have changed as a side effect of this change; we will retime them along with player dissolve at a later date.[/p][p][/p][h3]Server[/h3][list][*][p]Implemented fallback for custom hitbox rollbacks in case there isn’t enough accumulated data yet (done between patches to fix forever ghost players)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Changelogs #25.07.08 - Alpha
notes.content: [h1]Changelogs #25.07.08[/h1][p][/p][p]We are testing the new hitbox rollbacks for improved hit registration once again.[/p][p][/p][h3]Maps[/h3][p][/p][p]Ironworks[/p][list][*][p]Lights now react to settings[/p][/*][*][p]Added pillar collider that was missing[/p][/*][/list][p]Note: All maps either had very small fixes and/or small performance improvements, the latter being the case for Ironworks as well.[/p][p][/p][h3]Client[/h3][list][*][p]Reduced new smoothers interpolation time to 1 tick from 2 ticks[/p][/*][*][p]Potato quality settings now has slightly less, rounded 20 meters real time light distance as opposed to 22.5 meters[/p][/*][*][p]Character’s rim lighting now reacts to baked GI of the maps[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory now shows Archetype and Type of the weapons below the item name[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Server[/h3][list][*][p]Switched to custom hitbox rollbacks to match attacker vision back in time better[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Changelogs #25.06.03 - Alpha
notes.content:
Rough contents of this patch were already shared, and it went according to plan. We are still experimenting here a little, and bat is not out of WIP (Work in Progress) yet. As a side note, we have increased the level cap to 100 now as well.

[b]Gameplay[/b]

[list]
[*] Reduced dodge cancel time to 0.05s from 0.2s
[*] Improved weapon switching by allowing it to happen right away on every state except for attacks themselves
[*] Attack inputs now will be ignored in favor of weapon switch input, allowing you to attack with the next weapon as soon as the current attack ends
[*] Fixed networked input drops causing you to take a Rifle Cannon shot out of nowhere
[*] Blastable objects no longer respawn when a player was inside them in the last second (Experimental)
[/list]

[b]Game Modes

Team Deathmatch[/b]
[list]
[*] Reverted using mouse sensitivity settings on the spawn selection, it is back to using raw inputs again
[/list]

[b]Touchdown[/b]

[list]
[*] Added guide arrows that points at the enemy goal post when you pick up the ball
[*] Set player limit to 4v4 instead of 5v5 to reduce chaos (UI still has slots for 5, we are testing this out for now to get feedback on)
[/list]

[b]Maps
[/b]
[b]Ironworks[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some of the visual and collider issues
[*] Optimized volumetric lights
[/list]
[b]Outer Space[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some of the visual issues
[/list]
[b]Service Point[/b]
[list]
[*] Dimmed the lighting
[/list]

[b]Weapons[/b]

[b]Bat (Item: Cyclone)[/b]

[list]
[*] Added switch sound & kill icon
[*] Normal Attacks durations changed to 1s from 0.8s, and increased inherit movement duration accordingly
[*] Normal Attacks movement speed decreased to 0.5 from 0.6
[*] Normal Attacks hitbox size increased in front
[*] Normal Attack 1 attack cancelling dodge timing allowing time increased to 0.62s from 0.42s
[*] Normal Attack 2 attack cancelling dodge disabled
[*] Normal Attacks now allow jumping
[*] Spin Attack now allows attack cancelling dodge at 1.2s
[*] Spin Attack crowd control effect changed from Knockback to Stagger
[*] Jump Attack is now on LMB, and requires you to hold it for 0.2s similar to Strong Cut attack on Broadsword
[*] Jump Attack damage reduced to 37 from 40
[*] Jump Attack critical multiplier increased to 2.03 from 1.875
[/list]

[b]Swordgun (Item: Scorpio)
[/b]

[list]
[*] Removed attack cancelling dodge on shooting state
[*] Bullet radius increased to 3cm from 2.5cm
[*] Reduced Flux consumption of shooting, taking potential bullet count to 35 from 32
[*] Increased damage per bullet to 6.5 from 6
[*] Decreased shots critical multiplier to 1.2 from 1.25
[*] Damage drop off adjusted for a narrower midrange
[*] Swapped Stab hit 2 and 3 damages on all charge levels
[*] Stab hit 2 critical multiplier increased to 1.4 from 1.2 on all charge levels
[*] Stab hit 3 critical multiplier increased to 1.25 from 1.2 on all charge levels
[*] Charge now goes from 0 movement speed to 1 during the charge state instead of flat 0.4 movement speed multiplier
[/list]

[b]Broadsword (Item: Founders Sword / Durendal)[/b]

[list]
[*] Normal Attacks hitboxes and vfx adjusted to fit slash directions
[*] Normal Attacks damages increased to 16 from 15
[*] Normal Attack 1 movement speed decreased to 1.6 from 2
[*] Normal Attack 1 hits are delayed by 0.2s instead of 0.1s
[*] Normal Attack 1 critical multiplier decreased to 1.375 from 1.6
[*] Normal Attack 2 critical multiplier increased to 1.625 from 1.6
[*] Heavy Attacks critical multiplier decreased to 1.75 from 2
[*] Heavy Attack after Dash animation duration increased to 0.625s from 0.5s
[*] Heavy Attack after Dash movement speeds reduced at the start and cutting part to 0.8 and 0.25 from 1.2 and 0.35 respectively
[*] Dash Attack animation duration increased to 1.44s from 1.3s
[*] Dash Attack damage decreased to 14 x 3 from 16 x 3
[*] Dash Attack inherit movement speed decreased by 10%
[*] Dash Attack inherit movement durations reduced by 0.18s total

[/list]
[b]Rifle Cannon (Item: Helios)[/b]

[list]
[*] Jumps and fall no longer reset the zoom
[*]  Attack animation reduced to 0.75s from 0.86s and reduced inherit movement duration accordingly
[*] Decreased no charge ray damage to 15 from 18
[*] Increased max charge ray damage to 27 from 24
[*] Decreased critical multiplier for ray to 1.4 from 1.5

[/list]
[b]Revolver (Item: Resolver / Crimson Hound)
[/b]
[list]
[*] Central bullet damage increased to 10 from 7
[*] Outer bullet damage decreased to 6 from 8
[*] Outer bullet critical multipler decreased to 1.7 from 1.88
[/list]
[b]Client[/b]

[list]
[*] Made zoom and running FoV changes ~50% Faster
[*] Added hit marker sounds for guns with normal and critical variants
[*] Fixed leaderboard showing up on screen when the data is received after UI has already moved onto somewhere else
[*] Hidden Steam login options on Standalone as it only worked on Steam Client
[/list]

notes.title: Short-Term and Mid-Term (around 4weeks) Update Plan
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First, thank you all for playing our game and giving us valuable feedback! Since this Steam Early Access release, you have found many things for us to fix and improve, and once again provided us with what you want us to focus on first.

We want to tackle everything, but of course, it won't all be done right away. So here are our focus topics that we want to handle now:

1. Bug fixes
2. Gameplay experience
3. Onboarding for new players
4. Content

They are in order of how fast we can ship them to you, but that doesn't mean we will wait for one to get started on another. For instance, for the next patch we want to release (which we expect to go live early to mid next week):

- [Bug fix] Ironworks map fixes
- [Bug fix] Missed input drop fix
- [Gameplay experience] Overall weapon balancing (this is an ongoing one for the future as well)
- [Gameplay experience] Improved weapon switching
- [Gameplay experience] Additional hit sounds to improve hit feedback, starting with guns
- [Gameplay experience] Turning Touchdown player limit from 5v5 to 4v4 to reduce chaos

For mid-term (mostly within a month, but content creation usually takes a while), we have other things in mind, like:

- [Content] Resuming work on Bat weapon
- [Bug fix] Preventing dead players from stopping dashes
- [Gameplay experience] More distinction on melee hits to improve hit feedback
- [Onboarding for new players] Weapon information in the inventory
- [Gameplay experience] Showcasing possible shots left out of total for the current weapon flux (energy) in HUD
- [Gameplay experience] Showcasing when and which animation cancel you can do with an icon in the HUD
- [Gameplay experience] Input buffering for animation cancels
- [Onboarding for new players] A basic Tutorial, one that gets the core mechanics across
- [Content] Adding Heavy Machine Gun weapon

Of course, there will be more to come, and as is normal in game development, we might have to adjust some plans along the way. Still, we hope this gives you the gist of our current focus: improving the game.
